טבלה: מכלול פוליסה
This table details conditions related to policy cancellation due to misrepresentation or material changes. It outlines the timeframe (30 days) the insurer has to respond to incomplete or dishonest information and the consequences of such issues.
ממדים: Policy conditions related to misrepresentation or material changes, Timeframes and insurer rights
